name: layman
description: An optimization and execution layer that makes Codex development easier, less wasteful, and more reliable

interface.shortDescription: Turn ideas into verified software with less wasted AI work.
interface.longDescription: Layman helps beginners and developers understand a project, choose the smallest reliable workflow, control context and model effort, execute safely, and verify the result. Plus users get one-task automatic execution through their ChatGPT login; API users can use the privacy-first local Responses router.
defaultPrompt: Use $layman to turn my idea into the smallest verified software result.
Use $layman-status to explain where this project stands and what comes next.
Use $layman-auto to implement this task with the easiest reliable route.
